messages:
deploy-bot: Starting config-only deploy 'thin-batch-adjust' -> rolling to 10% canary now. Changes: routing.weighted=0.92, batch.window_ms: 6->4, request.timeout_ms: 3000->2500. Change window 09:30-10:30 PST. Canary targets: internal + 5% external tenants. CL: https://ci.internal/review/4421 :rocket:
leah: Ack. I'll watch the rollout page and post notes here. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards/release/thin-batch-adjust
sam: Heads-up: reducing batch window may increase KV-cache churn on hot contexts. If we see spike in KV cache miss rate, be ready to pin fallback model variant `gen-2-small` for heavy tenants (low mem).
kai: Oncall here — I'll watch p95/p99 latency and error rate. Pre-approved rollback triggers?
marta: Suggest rollback if error rate >0.5% for 3m OR p99 > 700ms sustained for 5m. Also abort if tail retries increase by 30%. @leah ok? :eyes:
leah: Fine with that. Also add temporary tenant-exclude for any tenant showing >2x baseline qps. If that happens, ops should exclude and notify infra.
deploy-bot: Canary at 10% complete — no elevated errors. p50/p95 within expected, p99 up ~120ms vs baseline (monitoring). Progressing to 50% after 5m observation.
ryan: One note: for a couple high-throughput tenants, routing.weighted change could push them into a different pool — recommend adding a `tenants.exclude = ["payroll-corp","realtime-chat"]` for the first 2 hours to avoid ripple.
sam: Agreed. I'll add a pin snippet to the config for heavy tenants so they hit `model_variant: gen-2-small` until warmup finishes. Patch: ```
routing:
  weighted: 0.92
  tenant_overrides:
    - tenant: payroll-corp
      model_variant: gen-2-small
    - tenant: realtime-chat
      model_variant: gen-2-small
batch:
  window_ms: 4
  max_batch_tokens: 1024
timeout_ms: 2500
```
kai: Noted. I'll escalate if p99 crosses 700ms.
deploy-bot: Roll progressed to 50% at 10:38 PST — brief p99 blip to 760ms for ~90s, auto-alert fired but metrics returned to 680ms within 2m. No rollback.
leah: Good catch. I'll keep tenant-excludes active for 60m and keep an eye on retries.
ryan: Thanks — will coordinate with partner teams to confirm no adverse effects on integrations.
deploy-bot: Roll finished to 100% at 10:45 PST. No sustained error/latency thresholds breached. Closing change window; leaving tenant-exclude for 30m as a safety buffer. Release notes: "Config-only: thin batch window, tighter timeout, routing weighted tweak, tenant pin overrides added for high-qps tenants."
leah: Ship it. I'll open a short follow-up doc with observed numbers and the canary playback. Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
